risks.risk: DSG High Needs block forecast overspend GBP 11.717m (2025/26), held in a RING-FENCED reserve with no revenue-budget impact. No evidence of a Safety Valve / High Needs Stability Grant agreement; the High Needs trajectory bears watching as the override approaches.

Reform UK inherits a Labour-set budget; the first Reform-set budget is 2027/28. The position is relatively comfortable (a GBP 2.2m savings programme, no additional in-year cuts), but the MTFS to 2027/28 is framed with a large degree of uncertainty.
Cost pressures of GBP 15.8m (demand 5.5m + pay 4.7m + price 5.6m) in 2026/27 funded largely by GBP 13.7m of grants + the council tax increase; grant dependency is a forward risk.
